geometry_note: Distance labels are not automatically treated as historical route changes. Require identical ordered stops on all seven calibration dates; use the larger API/master length for energy. Reused historical street path remains a scenario assumption.
vehicle_note: Karsan e-JEST M2 wheelchair layout supports 16 passengers excluding driver. Domestic type approval, subsidy eligibility, route clearance and actual prices are unverified. Scenario uses a 5t operating mass; manufacturer gross mass is not curb mass. Reference is a common 7t electric model, not a surveyed existing fleet.
capital_note: No fabricated market price. Calculate maximum justified net annualized capital premium and operating electricity savings; labour, depot and maintenance excluded. Fleet caps are scenarios, not actual procurement budgets.
